note: Calibrated from a real Serum 2 editor, Init patch. ENV was captured via the Mosh host (Mosh --demo3 → screencapture the 'Serum 2' window); OSC A + FILTER were calibrated from a full-res Ableton-hosted capture and converted into this same Mosh-window reference space (the two windows differ only by a ~25px title-bar offset: same x, Mosh cy = Ableton cy + 25). Coords are in the reference_size pixel space; load_profile() scales them to the actual frame. Knobs read via the blue_tick reader: Serum marks each value with a saturated BLUE tick at the rim (robust on Serum 2's glossy skin, where the white-pointer read is dragged toward 0.5 by the bright top-bevel highlight; falls back to the white pointer on non-default skins). ENV 1 has no DELAY knob (unlike Vital): ATK/HOLD/DEC/SUS/REL.

landmark.note: SERUM 2 wordmark (top-left, on dark skin, just below the host title bar). Host-invariant calibration template-matches this to correct title-bar height differences between hosts (Mosh's window is ~26px taller than Ableton's at full res → every content-y is shifted). template/bbox are in the png's px (cut from serum_init.png at 0.6x ref); ref_xy = bbox[:2]/template_scale.

tabs._note: highlight is 'bright' (hue+saturation AGNOSTIC): Serum's active-tab dot renders GREEN (Mosh/standalone), BLUE (Ableton), OR white (the MIX tab) — same plugin, host/page-dependent — so only BRIGHTNESS is invariant (the active dot is brighter than the dim grey inactive dots). The band y is host-corrected by the logo landmark, so 'bright' lands only on the dots row, not the matrix curve graphics / preset text elsewhere.

matrix._note: MATRIX tab. Calibrated from serum2_matrix.png (Ableton-hosted, 1190x759) but stored in THIS Mosh reference space (2380x1544) — host-invariant calibration (the logo landmark) corrects the Mosh↔Ableton title-bar offset, so the SAME coords read either host. Columns: SOURCE | CRV | AMOUNT(horizontal bipolar slider) | POL | DESTINATION | OUT | AUX SOURCE | INV | CRV | OUTPUT. amount x0/x1 are SYMMETRIC about the centered (neutral=0.5 → no modulation) handle so an Init row reads inactive; source/dest cells are deliberately narrow to EXCLUDE the saturated CRV curve thumbnails and the blue POL arrow (which would otherwise read as 'occupied' and hallucinate a routing). Only the empty Init matrix is validated (read_matrix → []); per-row AMOUNT value scale + rows>8 await a POPULATED Serum 2 matrix capture.

fx_addrack._note: FX tab — Serum 2's DYNAMIC add-rack (≠ Serum 1's / Vital's FIXED rack, which the fx_list block + detect_fx_chain handle). You press '+ FX' and pick from a menu (Bode/Chorus/Compressor/Convolve/Delay/Distortion/Equalizer/Filter/Flanger/Hyper-Dimension/Phaser/Reverb/…); chosen modules STACK top-to-bottom per BUS (MAIN/BUS 1/BUS 2), empty on Init. The compact LEFT chain LIST (one row per added module, in order, each = a colored accent bar + the effect NAME in clean caps, pitch row_h) is the read surface — far cleaner than the expanded module panels on the right; rows are contiguous from the top, so read_addrack stops at the first empty row. read_addrack reads ONE visible bus (which it NAMES from the orange active-tab highlight — see bus_tabs); the teardown pipeline captures each bus separately. NAMES are identified by template-matching the name strip against profiles/serum_fxnames/<effect>.png (canonical-size, resolution-normalized). The bank ships 12 effects — the full audible set (bode/chorus/compressor/convolve/delay/distortion/equalizer/filter/flanger/hyper_dimension[→'Hyper/Dimension' via display_names]/phaser/reverb). Threshold: correct real-row matches floor at ~0.90 while the WORST cross-effect collision (phaser×reverb, two 6-letter words) is 0.747, so match_min 0.82 sits in the gap — accepts every correct name, rejects every look-alike. An effect WITHOUT a template (the 4 rare routing utils — Splitter L/H, L/M/H, M/S, Utility — are a documented follow-up) degrades to name=null/status='unidentified' (still detected as PRESENT) rather than a confident-wrong guess. Pure CV, no OCR, no runtime binary. Add a template PNG (+ a display_names entry if the name has a slash/space) to extend, like adding a profile. PER-MODULE BYPASS detection is DEFERRED: the live session could not confirm Serum 2's OFF visual (clicking the row power glyph never greyed the module across repeated A/B captures), so on=true for every present module (in an add-rack a module's PRESENCE is the load-bearing signal — you remove rather than bypass). Calibrated LIVE via computer-use (Ableton-hosted Serum 2); coords in reference space, host-corrected by the logo landmark. Fixtures: serum2_fx_loaded.png (Chorus→Distortion→Reverb→Delay→Compressor, MAIN), serum2_fx_bus1_empty.png (empty, BUS 1), serum2_fx_bus2_empty.png (empty, BUS 2), serum2_fx_bus2_flanger.png (Flanger=unidentified, BUS 2), serum2_fx.png (empty, MAIN).

bus_tabs._note: The active bus tab carries an ORANGE highlight; classify by snapping the orange centroid's reference-x to the nearest anchor. NB the tabs REFLOW — the active tab widens, so positions shift with selection — but the active (wide) tab's centre per bus is still well-separated (MAIN 133 / BUS 1 294 / BUS 2 452, each measured in its own active state; boundaries ~213/373), so nearest-anchor is robust.

bar._reserved: NOT yet consumed by read_addrack — the colored accent bar at this x (per-effect hue, S 71-189 / V high) is the candidate signal for FUTURE per-module bypass detection once the OFF visual is confirmed. Kept here as calibrated coords for that follow-up, not a current detection step.

_controls_note: ENV 1 ADSR + OSC A/B/C + NOISE + FILTER 1. OSC A/B/C are identical panels (x-pitch +540 per panel); each has WT POS, UNISON (number box, omitted), DETUNE, BLEND, PAN, DUAL warp (warp1/warp2), LEVEL. PHASE/RAND are tiny header value-displays (omitted). NOISE: FINE/PAN/PITCH/LEVEL (START/RAND are number boxes). Filter is a 2x3 knob grid (CUTOFF/RES/PAN over DRIVE/FAT/MIX) plus a vertical LEVEL slider (not a knob); FILTER 2 shares these same coords via the filter tab toggle. The blue_tick reader records each knob's normalized POSITION [0,1].
